Name: Ishmael, Son of Nethaniah
Summary: Ishmael, son of Nethaniah, of the seed royal, came with ten men to Gedaliah at Mizpah, ate with him, and slew him and the Jews and Chaldeans with him, then fled to Ammon.
RelatedPeople: Gedaliah, Son of Ahikam; Nethaniah, Father of Ishmael; Elishama, Grandfather of Ishmael; Gedaliah; Johanan, Son of Kareah; Jeremiah
LifeLesson: Royal blood without loyalty is the most dangerous kind of treason.
